name: Nicole

scaling.scaled: Banded pull-ups or a fixed set of 5-10 ring rows per round; keep the max-set scoring if using bands. Runs stay 400m.
scaling.beginner: 200-300m runs with max-rep ring rows. The run-recover-hang rhythm is the point. Any pulling movement preserves it.

origin.summary: Twenty minutes of 400m runs, each followed by a max set of pull-ups. The round ends when you drop off the bar. The score is total pull-ups, which makes it an unusual strategic puzzle: shorter sets mean more running, bigger sets mean earlier grip failure. First posted to CrossFit.com on 2006-12-11.

description: A 20-minute AMRAP of a 400m run and max-rep pull-ups, scored by rounds plus total pull-up reps. Pull-up capacity becomes the limiting factor as fatigue accumulates.
source_notes: crossfit.com/faq/wod (official CrossFit FAQ, 'Explain The Workouts with Names (the Girls)?'), retrieved 2026-07-08
